highlights.description: Communication graph analysis framework for email corpora with centrality, community detection, and visualization exports
Multi-format email ingestion (mbox, maildir) with identity resolution and thread reconstruction
Gephi (GEXF) and Neo4j (Cypher) export for graph visualization and querying

added.description: Core entity types: Actor, Interaction, Message, Thread
Weight profile system with influence, information_flow, and coordination profiles
Storage interfaces and in-memory implementation with JSON serialization
Graph abstraction layer using omniretrieve
Identity resolution with SCIM-based actor management and alias merging
Email adapters for mbox and maildir formats with header parsing
Thread reconstruction using References and In-Reply-To headers
Centrality analysis: PageRank, degree (in/out/total), betweenness
Community detection: Louvain algorithm with configurable resolution
Temporal analysis with burst detection and activity patterns
Path analysis: shortest paths, average path length, graph diameter
Bridge detection for identifying cross-community connectors
External entity analysis with boundary spanner identification
GEXF export for Gephi visualization with centrality and community attributes
Neo4j Cypher export with schema creation and batched statements
JSON and CSV export formats for analysis results
CLI with pipeline, ingest, analyze, export, and identity commands
Session persistence for sharing state across CLI invocations
Configuration file support (.commgraph.yaml) with environment variable overrides
Enron corpus support with pre-curated employee identity data via enron-people package

fixed.description: Nil pointer dereference in centrality and bridge detection algorithms
Identity resolver call to non-existent function

documentation.description: Product Requirements Document (PRD) and Technical Requirements Document (TRD)
MkDocs documentation site with getting started, user guide, and reference sections
Enron corpus tutorial with step-by-step analysis examples
CLI reference with all commands, flags, and examples
Configuration guide with YAML examples and environment variable mapping

tests.description: Entity type unit tests for Actor, Interaction, Message, Thread
Analysis algorithm tests for centrality, community, and temporal analysis
Email adapter tests for mbox and maildir parsing
End-to-end integration tests for full pipeline

dependencies.description: Add enron-people v0.1.1 for Enron corpus identity data
Add spf13/viper v1.21.0 for configuration file support
Add spf13/cobra v1.10.2 for CLI framework
Add omniretrieve v0.2.0 for graph abstraction
Add enmime v1.3.0 for MIME email parsing
